unit: Distil Sources retrieval and pinpoint excerpt
description: A GET-only probe of official WA and federal legal source URLs that runs the production verification logic plus a scored, pinpoint-centred excerpt.
why_it_exists: Every Act's HTML opens with a table of contents that repeats each section heading verbatim, so first-match anchoring returned the contents listing and last-match anchoring returned whichever later section happened to reuse the phrase. Citations were being stored against the contents page instead of the provision.

candidates.label: Limitation Act 2005 (WA) s 13
want: An action on any cause of action cannot be commenced

candidates.label: Road Traffic Act 1974 (WA) ss 55-56
want: Driver in incident occasioning property damage to stop and give information

candidates.label: Motor Vehicle (Third Party Insurance) Act 1943 (WA) s 4
Minimum Conditions of Employment Act 1993 (WA) s 9A
FW Act epub part 2
want: The National Employment Standards are minimum standards

candidates.label: FW Act epub part 3
want: The National Employment Standards are minimum standards

assertions: In the stripped body text a real heading is preceded by a section-number marker rendered as digits, a space and a dot ('55 .Driver in incident...'), while the contents listing has none ('55.Driver in incident...'); scoring on that marker makes the body win without hardcoding each heading's spacing.
A candidate occurrence scores +10 for the heading marker, +4 for provision-like text following it ('(1)', '(a)', 'means ', 'must ', 'is not to be'), and -3 when followed only by a page number.
Stripped text of 400 characters or fewer is RETRIEVAL_FAILED, not an empty excerpt.
A URL whose path is empty is LANDING_PAGE_NOT_AUTHORITY however much text it returns - a landing page is never a citable authority.

Text matching the blocked pattern (enable javascript, access denied, are you a robot, request blocked, captcha, 403 forbidden, cloudflare) in its first 3000 characters is BLOCKED_BY_SITE, which is how an Angular app shell is caught.
Text without any legal structure marker (section N, s N, Part, Division, Schedule, subsection) is NO_PINPOINT_FOUND.
The probe issues GET requests only, with neverError and a 30 second timeout so a transport failure is classified rather than thrown, and writes nothing to any sheet.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "integration": not executed by harness/run.js.
